ops.title: FP-domain Finder Locations clutter RESOLVED 2026-07-14 — isHidden proven on-machine; plain upgrade+daemon restart retrofits existing domains (add() updates properties), no fp repair sweep needed
ops.body:
The Finder-sidebar "Locations" clutter was only the File Provider domains (fuse mounts are nobrowse, symlink accounts mount nothing). Fix = `NSFileProviderDomain.isHidden = true` in the widget's `FileProviderController.swift` `register(_:)` + `probe()`; shipped **v0.52.1** (commit b5223e3a).

**RESOLVED on the primary Mac 2026-07-14.** The Mac ran cask 0.52.0 (pre-fix app), so all 12 domains stayed visible. Remediation: `brew upgrade cc-pool` + `brew upgrade --cask cc-pool-status` (→ v0.54.0), `brew services restart cc-pool` (cask auto-relaunched the app). **All 12 domains vanished from Finder with only one explicit `ccp fp repair --account 8`** — the daemon's reconcile re-register flows through the new app and `NSFileProviderManager.add()` on an existing domain UPDATES its properties in place; the planned "one repair per account when idle" sweep was unnecessary (cc-notes note 991640d3). Zero of ~47 live sessions disturbed; domains stay registered (hidden ≠ removed), reads verified, doctor clean.

Durable facts:
- `isHidden` DOES drop the Finder Locations entry (on-machine proven; public macOS 11+ API); files stay on disk and serve through `getUserVisibleURL`.
- Domain-property retrofits need NO remove+re-add — upgrade + daemon restart suffices; `ccp fp repair` is only for wedged replicas.
- Gotcha: `ccp service install` can print "✓ Started the daemon" while the OLD daemon keeps running, and `ccp status --json`'s top-level `version` is the snapshot-writer's version, not the daemon's. Reliable restart = `brew services restart cc-pool`; the version mismatch surfaces via `ccp fp repair`'s health check.
- yasyf-home is symlink-parked ([[fp-backend-rollout]]) — nothing to hide there. FP was deliberately chosen over fuse to avoid the [[macos-nfs-vinvalbuf2-panic]] class — do NOT "fix" sidebar issues by migrating off FP. Related: [[stale-widget-appex-reap]], [[cc-pool-fileprovider-signing-reality]].
